name: TrueSignal Hub change that can blind detection
description: A successful admin change on the Hub that can suppress or erase detection: SIEM/webhook/whitelist/known-scanner config, disarming, silencing a sensor, deleting nodes, sensors, beacons or events, archiving all events, replacing the asset inventory, password change, recovery-code regeneration or factory reset. Change tracking for review; high for evidence destruction (clear events, factory reset).
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: Every routine admin change. Review, do not page, except for the high-severity actions.
note:
## Triage
1. `event.action` is `METHOD /route`; `url.path` the concrete path (node and sensor IDs). Request bodies are never logged.
2. Match against the change calendar. `source.ip` is the admin's client.
3. `DELETE /api/v2/events` or `POST /api/v2/system/reset` outside a planned change: treat as tampering; events are still in the SIEM.
query: event.dataset:"truesignal.audit" and event.outcome:"success" and event.action:("PATCH /api/v2/config" or "PATCH /api/v2/system/state" or "PATCH /api/v2/system/password" or "POST /api/v2/system/reset" or "PATCH /api/v2/nodes/{nodeId}/sensors/{sensorId}/silence" or "DELETE /api/v2/nodes/{nodeId}" or "DELETE /api/v2/nodes/{nodeId}/sensors/{sensorId}" or "DELETE /api/v2/events" or "PATCH /api/v2/events/archive-all" or "DELETE /api/v2/beacons/{beaconId}" or "PUT /api/v2/assets" or "POST /api/v2/auth/mfa/recovery-codes")
